_key.description: Variant key, phenotype ontology term and source file accession joined by underscores.

effect_size.description: Estimated phenotype effect size (mu or mu_adj)

z_score.description: Z-score of the variant's effect size, as the posterior mean over its uncertainty. Files that calibrate against the negative-control variants report the adjusted z-score (mu_z_adj) instead of the raw one.

significant.description: Boolean indicator of the significance of the variant effect on the phenotype.

num_guides.description: Number of guides aggregated across the variant in the screen.

edit_rate_mean.description: Mean effective prime-editing rate across the variant's guides: the fraction of cells edited, from 0 to 1.

effect_size_ci95_lower.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for effect size. Taken from the source file when present; otherwise the Wald interval around effect_size using the reported standard deviation.

effect_size_ci95_upper.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for effect size. Taken from the source file when present; otherwise the Wald interval around effect_size using the reported standard deviation.

p_value_adj.description: Multiple-testing-adjusted p-value (FDR) when reported by the source.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: Negative log10 of the multiple-testing-adjusted p-value when reported by the source.

biological_context.example: human HCT116 cell line from donor(s) IGVFDO0384OZRW

accessible_via.return: name, class, label, method, crispr_modality, source, source_url, files_filesets, biological_context, biosample_term, effect_size, z_score, significant, num_guides, edit_rate_mean, effect_size_ci95_lower, effect_size_ci95_upper, p_value_adj, neg_log10_pvalue_adj
